content: Our interpretation of the results is that BERT mostly did not learn the meaning of negation. The impressive results in QA suggest that pretrained language models are able to memorize aspects of specific facts; but, apparently, they ignore negation markers in many cases and rely on the co-occurrence of the subject with the original relation only. One reason for the poor performance we observe probably is that negated statements occur much less in training corpora than positive statements.
